Free tools for your yard and garden, built by soil scientists. Work out how much material you actually need, check a quote before you pay it, water smarter, and make soil decisions with the working shown.

No ads, no sign-up, and no supplier pays to be listed. Every tool shows how its numbers are calculated, so you can check them yourself.

## Buying materials

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### [Landscape materials calculator](materials-calculator.qmd)
How much topsoil, compost, mulch, gravel, road base, sand, sod or grass seed to order, for any shape of yard, in yards, tons, bags or pallets.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Quote checker](quote-checker.qmd)
See what depth a quote really covers, whether it's more than you need, and the price per yard and per ton. Includes a yards-to-tons converter.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Raised bed and planter soil](planter-soil.qmd)
Soil for raised beds, pots and planters, how to fill deep beds for less, and how much soil a tree needs.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Fertilizer label calculator](fertilizer-calculator.qmd)
Turn the N-P-K numbers into how much to spread, and compare the real cost per pound of nutrient.
:::
:::

## Watering

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### [Sprinkler catch-cup test](catch-cup-test.qmd)
Measure what each zone really puts down, and how evenly, to set run times.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Cycle-and-soak scheduler](cycle-and-soak.qmd)
Stop runoff on clay and slopes by splitting watering into short cycles.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Drip irrigation calculator](drip-irrigation.qmd)
Run times and emitters per plant, and whether the zone can supply them.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Lawn vs low-water landscape](lawn-water.qmd)
Compare a season's water use and cost for lawns, low-water plantings and mulch.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Rain barrel calculator](rain-harvest.qmd)
How much your roof collects per storm and per year, and how fast a barrel fills.
:::
:::

## Your soil

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### [Soil test translator](soil-test-translator.qmd)
A lab report in plain English: what to do, and what you don't need to buy.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Should I amend my soil?](should-i-amend.qmd)
Check before you buy compost, topsoil or sand, for what you're planting.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [DIY soil tests](diy-soil-tests.qmd)
Jar, ribbon and drainage tests: find your texture and how fast your soil drains.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Soil pH: lime and sulfur](ph-adjustment.qmd)
How much to raise or lower pH, and when lowering it isn't realistic.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Compost mix calculator](compost-mix.qmd)
Balance greens and browns, and fix a smelly or slow pile.
:::
:::

## Drainage, building and trees

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### [Foundation grading check](foundation-grading.qmd)
Does the ground slope away from your house enough, and how much fill to fix it.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Rain garden and dry well](rain-garden.qmd)
Size a rain garden or dry well from your roof area and how fast your soil drains.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [New-build yard soil check](construction-soil-check.qmd)
Find out if construction left you thin topsoil over compacted subsoil, and what to ask your builder.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Frost depth](frost-depth.qmd)
How deep the ground freezes where you live, for water lines, footings and fence posts.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### [Tree protection zone](tree-protection.qmd)
How much space to fence off around a tree before construction or digging.
:::
:::
